## Highlights

- **Improved interface and localization:** Updated translations across all supported languages, refined interface descriptions and settings guidance, and improved consistency in terminology and language-specific wording.
- **Clearer streaming transitions:** Added persistent titles identifying whether an application is starting, resuming or closing, together with more informative contextual status messages below the progress bar.
- **Improved navigation feedback:** Fixed an issue that could prevent gamepad navigation sounds from playing under certain conditions.
- **Accurate host status information:** Fixed the host details dialog incorrectly reporting hosts as online and paired regardless of their actual status.
- **Clearer Dolby audio diagnostics:** Renamed the audio decoding information in the performance statistics overlay to explicitly identify sound decoding, avoiding confusion with video decoding.
